notes.title: New VN RELEASED: The Hepatica Spring!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/c088f07223a2765ed7f7e14b9559c90e6fec6c1a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our latest VN is now released![/h1]
[b]The Hepatica Spring[/b] is a Nordic fairytale-inspired, fluffy fantasy story full of magic! It's a lighthearted romp with no bad endings--just relax and enjoy the adventure!
[list][*] [b]Genre:[/b] Visual Novel, modern fantasy, comedy, (optional) romance
[*] [b]Routes:[/b] 3 (romantic or friendship/platonic)
[*] [b]Length:[/b] ~50,000 words
[*] [b]Additional Features:[/b]
    - Name the main character
    - Play as any gender you please
    - Pet the best drog (dragon-dog) of all time: Digby![/list]
Who will you dance with this Midsummer's eve? 💙

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1883990/The_Hepatica_Spring

notes.title: Red Embrace: Paradisus Alpha Now LIVE on Patreon!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/1854abd5fd674c17c0ef3c9562d93639de33f14d.jpg[/img]

We’re super excited to announce that the very first playable version of [b]Red Embrace: Paradisus[/b] can now be accessed via our [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/61246678][b]Patreon![/b][/url]

Our plan** for RE:P is to release monthly Patreon updates for the alpha, until we’re ready to enter [b]Steam Early Access[/b]—hopefully sometime in early 2023. The funds from Patreon will go towards RE:P’s development, and the community will also be able to significantly contribute to the final game through feedback/suggestions/playtesting.

Thinking about signing up? Check out the info post on [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/61246678][b]Patreon[/b][/url] and get your Steam key to start playing!

notes.title: NEW GAME—Red Embrace: Paradisus!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/1a9000943119c22f6c88d2b4d9c4b328e744e8b9.jpg[/img]

Announcing our newest project—[i][b]Red Embrace: Paradisus![/b][/i]

Red Embrace: Paradisus (RE:P) is an immersive vampire sim/narrative RPG. Inspired by [i]Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines, Disco Elysium[/i], and the [i]Shadowrun [/i]series, RE:P seeks to create a dark, fully story-driven (no combat) vampire experience with branching narrative and multiple endings.

Check out the game below and add it to your wishlist! <3

Follow the [b][url=https://twitter.com/REParadisus]RE:P Twitter page[/url][/b] and join our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/p3pM8rj]Discord[/url][/b] for more info/discussion. :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752210/Red_Embrace_Paradisus

notes.title: Final Day Bugfix!
notes.content:
Hello all!

We've been hunting down the odd freeze/textbox hanging bug on Night 3. It [i]should[/i] be fixed now, but please let us know if the issue is still occurring!

Make sure your game is properly updated (may require a restart of Steam). If it still doesn't work, some users have said that pressing the TAB key will bring up the textbox again. 

Thanks so much for your patience.
